== Description ==

[[Joe Olson]] (left) handing over a card, with [[Logan Pietig]] (seated right), [[Sam Tashima]] (standing centre-left, red pullover and glasses), and a second standing spectator (centre-right, unlabeled) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
